section_2.title: Common questions about studying with YStudy.
section_2.description: Find answers about courses, funding, eligibility, applications and adviser support.

faqs.question: Is YStudy guidance free?
faqs.answer: Yes. YStudy guidance is free for students.

faqs.question: Do I need to know the course already?
faqs.answer: No. Choose “not sure” in the form and an adviser can help you shortlist routes.

faqs.question: Can I apply as a mature student?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many YStudy users are working adults returning to education.

faqs.question: Is Student Finance guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Student Finance and admission decisions are made by the official provider or funding body.
